The Quality of the Room

About HQ

HQ is an invite-only sanctuary for executives, founders, athletes, and legacy builders — a third place, apart from home and work, where the caliber of the company is the amenity.

We gather to exchange signal, cultivate judgment, and support meaningful work. Membership is capped at four hundred, referred, and vetted — a community built intentionally on substance over spectacle.

We aren't building a crowd. We are protecting a standard.

What We Believe

The Manifesto

The modern world is optimized for reach.
We built HQ for depth.

Some rooms change the trajectory of a life. This is one of them — hand-laid brick, a door that closes, and the right people inside it.

We look past the résumé.
Titles get you noticed. Character gets you in.

We ask what you are building, who you lift, and what you leave behind in a room.

The public persona stops at the door. Nothing here is content. Everything here is off the record.

Four hundred chairs, and not one more.

Est. 1900

The Southworth Block

Built in 1900 by Henry L. Southworth, Southworth Hall is one of Provo's most iconic historic structures — original brickwork, vaulted ceilings, hand-hewn wood. Reimagined as the home of HQ, it holds timeless architecture to a modern purpose.

Five minutes from the I-15 corridor and steps from the valley's institutional anchors — the utility of a serious workspace, the quiet luxury of an elite social lounge.

108 West Center Street, Provo, Utah

Capped at Four Hundred

Membership Prospectus

Membership at HQ is equity — it appreciates, and it transfers at market value. It is granted by invitation or vetted application, and activates only when paid in full.

Not everyone who applies will be invited. Not everyone invited will apply.

Initiation · Equity

The first hundredUpon invitation
The second hundredUpon invitation
The final hundredUpon invitation

Initiation is tiered by chair, and fully transferable at market value — the earlier the chair, the better its terms. Figures are disclosed with your invitation.

Monthly Dues

SingleUpon invitationOne named member. Full access to lounge, grooming, and workspace.
ExecutiveUpon invitationOne named member, with guest privileges for up to two at a time.
CorporateUpon invitationTwo named members, each with guest privileges for up to two.
  • Referral required. Every applicant is referred by a member in good standing.
  • Due diligence. Every applicant is screened, thoroughly.
  • Board approval. Final membership is granted by HQ's board.
  • We look past the résumé. Titles get you noticed; character gets you in. Arrogance and entitlement are declined, whatever the title.
